gates.name: safety-validation
gates.reason: Proposed selector matches 3 different elements on the page

gates.name: stability-analysis
gates.reason: nth-child selector is highly unstable across page variations

details: Proposed selector 'button:nth-child(3)' is position-based and will break if button order changes
3 elements match the proposed selector, causing ambiguity
Original selector '.checkout-btn' has semantic meaning that is lost in the proposal
Stability analysis shows 72% failure rate for nth-child selectors in similar contexts
recommendations: Use a more specific selector: button[type="submit"][aria-label="Complete Checkout"]
Add data-testid attribute to the checkout button in the application code
